# Third-party code

| Directory | Project | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `cpp-httplib/` | [cpp-httplib](https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib) 0.67.0 by Yuji Hirose (as vendored in llama.cpp b12778) | MIT, see `cpp-httplib/LICENSE` |
| `nlohmann/` | [JSON for Modern C++](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) 3.12.0 by Niels Lohmann | MIT, see the header of `nlohmann/json.hpp` |

QNX SDP, llama.cpp and the language models are not included in this repository. The build downloads them.
